sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form, having won four of their last five matches (with one draw), and face a struggling Alsager side currently bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 games. This should represent a straightforward opportunity for Sandbach to maintain their title push.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a mid-table clash, with Stafford looking to bounce back from their most recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a battle between third and fifth in the table—a significant fixture with both clubs in strong positions, though Bridgnorth did suffer a recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in another upper-mid-table meeting. Bilston Town, currently sixth, host Foley Meir in a contest between two teams with solid recent form. Market Drayton Town face New Mills, with both struggling in the lower half after recent poor runs. Shawbury United, winless in five matches, host struggling Barnton, who at least have drawn two of their last three. Cheadle Heath Nomads, one of the division's poorest performers, visit Telford Town in a basement-battle fixture. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a clash between two lower-table sides, with Crewe looking to recover from successive defeats. Brereton Social, home to Widnes Town on Saturday, face the division's bottom club who have won just once all season and have lost four of their last five.
